title: Apple to Scan Shared iCloud Links for Harmful Content
excerpt: Apple announces plans to scan iCloud items accessible via shared links for harmful content in upcoming software updates.
body_html:
Apple has announced that it will begin checking certain iCloud items for harmful content starting with upcoming software updates, including iOS 27.3. The new scanning measure will apply to items that are shared and can be accessed by anyone with the link.

According to the company, the feature will be included in version 27.3 and later releases across several operating systems, including iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS.
